name: Naina Sura Dewana
bio: Dewana wants a claim heard before it becomes a story about his loyalties. The merchant hearing his offer can distinguish the gift from what others say it meant.
notes: fact: Brown calls him a leading merchant and records a gift in the dispute, without giving him a port office or a later fate (Brown ch. XXII, pp. 161–164)
gameplay: The cargo dispute and the dialogue are invented. He is not Nina Chatu (people-factions.md §2)
